title: Woven []byte->string conversion always heap-allocates, even with IAST inactive
claim: string(iastprop.BytesToString(b)) returns string(value) from a non-inlinable generic wrapper (cost 131) and internal.BytesToString leaks result to heap via AdoptString, so non-escaping <=32B conversions lose stack allocation in every root package regardless of IAST state; README 'allocation-preserving' is inaccurate.
repro_command: go tool orchestrion go test -count=1 -run TestReviewWovenAllocs -v ./zzreview/ (woven: 1 alloc; unwoven: 0)

title: Woven concat forces operands to escape; "lit"+string(b) gains an allocation even when inactive
claim: copy(inputs[:n], elements[:n]) in joinStringHit makes every Concat operand leak to heap, defeating the zero-copy slicebytetostringtmp for "p"+string(b) and any stack operand; +1 alloc per call independent of IAST state. Index-loop copy fixes it (verified in trial).
repro_command: go tool orchestrion go test -count=1 -run TestReviewWovenAllocs -v ./zzreview/ ; go build -gcflags=-m=2 ./internal/taint/propagation/

title: JSONString reports success and telemetry even when no owner adopted the clone
claim: AdoptString result is ignored; when all adoptions fail it still returns (clone,true) and records executed/coarse telemetry, causing a needless SetString of an untracked clone.

title: JSON literal range includes delimiting quotes; quote-only taint coarsens whole value
claim: Intersection window is the raw token including quotes, so taint touching only a delimiter taints the entire decoded string.

title: Concat tests do not pin offsets; operator benchmarks run unwoven
claim: Arity tests only assert IsTaintedString with the tainted operand last; no exact-offset tests for first/middle/multiple operands; BenchmarkOperator*Inactive live in a package excluded from operator aspects so they measure native code and cannot catch F1/F2.

title: Tainted concat path repeats snapshot lookups per owner
claim: collectStringOwners looks up every operand, then stringOwnerRanges re-looks up each operand per owner: up to 16+4x17 Lookups per tainted Concat16.
